effects: You twist your ankle, causing you to stumble. You fall Prone.
You are struck by a rattling blow in your leg, causing it to temporarily go numb. Your Speed is reduced one step for 1 minute.
You suffer a laceration to the leg. You are Bleeding.
treatment: A Routine (+20) Medicae Test to stop the bleeding; application of bandages; or the laceration will close naturally after 1 hour.

effects: Your calf is sliced open, sending jolts of pain through your leg. You are Bleeding and drop any item held in the hand.
treatment: A Challenging (+0) Medicae Test to stop the Bleeding; application of bandages; or the laceration will close naturally after 1 hour.

effects: The strike dislocates your knee. You have Disadvantage on Tests that rely on mobility, and your Move is reduced one step. At the start of each turn while you have a dislocated knee you must make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Pain) Test. On a failure, you are Stunned until the start of your next turn.
treatment: A Challenging (+0) Medicae Test to pop the knee back into place.

effects: The attack tears off one of your toes. You are Bleeding (Major).
treatment: A Challenging (+0) Medicae Test performed by someone with the Chirurgeon Talent.

effects: The attack fractures a bone in your leg. Your leg is completely useless, and you drop any item held in the hand. Additionally, you must make a Challenging (+0) Fortitude (Pain) Test or be Stunned for one minute.
treatment: A Difficult (-10) Medicae Test to treat shock. This Test does not count as treating the broken bone.

effects: You suffer a deep cut on your leg, reducing your effectiveness. You are Bleeding (Major) and have Disadvantage on all Tests using the leg, such as jumping or climbing.
treatment: A Difficult (-10) Medicae Test using a chirurgeon’s kit to stop the Bleeding.

effects: The blow devastates your foot, breaking bones and potentially severing toes. You are Bleeding (Major), immediately fall Prone, and your Move is reduced one step. Additionally, you lose 1d10 – 5 toes. If your result is 0, you manage to keep all of your digits. Otherwise, you suffer the Amputation (Toes) Injury.
treatment: A Difficult (-10) Medicae Test performed by someone with the Chirurgeon Talent.

effects: The attack shatters the bones in your knee. Your leg is completely useless, and you immediately drop any item held in the hand. Additionally, you must make a Difficult (-10) Fortitude (Pain) Test or be Stunned for one minute.
treatment: A Hard (-20) Medicae Test to treat shock. This Test does not count as treating the broken bone.

effects: Your foot is played apart, causing a major injury and severing toes. You are Bleeding (Major) and Stunned for 1 hour. Additionally, you must make a Difficult (-10) Fortitude (Pain) Test or be Stunned for one minute.
treatment: A Hard (-20) Medicae Test performed by someone with the Chirurgeon Talent or similar expertise.

effects: You suffer a serious wound to a major artery. You are Bleeding (Major), Fatigued from blood loss, your leg is completely useless, and you immediately drop any item held in the hand.
treatment: A Hard (-20) Medicae Test using a chirurgeon’s kit to stop the Bleeding.

effects: Your foot is taken clean off. You are Bleeding (Major) and Stunned for 1 hour.
treatment: A Very Hard (-30) Medicae Test performed by someone with the Chirurgeon Talent or similar expertise.

effects: Your leg is mangled and torn apart, with only the barest piece of flesh attaching it to your body. Your leg is completely useless, and you drop any item held in the hand. Additionally, you must make a Very Hard (-30) Fortitude (Pain) Test or be Stunned for 1 hour. If you suffer any further Damage to the leg, you automatically suffer the Brutal Dismemberment Critical Wound and die.
treatment: A Very Hard (-30) Medicae Test performed by someone with the Chirurgeon Talent or similar expertise to fully remove the leg.

effects: Your leg is completely destroyed and torn from your body, causing shock and catastrophic blood loss. You are dead.
